messages:
Ivy: Spun up q7-small-int4 for a quick eval. Noticing regressions on our promptset for multi-paragraph summarization (promptset M). Suspect dedupe/anchor mismatch after quant shift.
Ben: Any diffs yet? small deltas can be noise.
Ivy: Quick numbers vs q6b: BLEU -0.9, ROUGE-L -1.8, hallucination metric +0.05. Failures skew to examples with repeated named entities and truncated context windows.
Asha: Could be seedbank overlap causing golden mismatch. We recently merged a sparse anchor bank that changed sample ordering. Recommend a targeted 150-sample golden refresh and a de-dup sweep using fuzzyhash threshold 0.82.
Ivy: Good call. I'll produce the sample list and run the fuzzyhash de-dupe locally.
label-bot: Created task LR-501 for "q7-small-int4 golden refresh" (150 items), priority: medium.
Ben: Also run an eval matrix: q7-small-int8, q7-small-int4 (old kernel), q7-small-int4 (new kernel). If int8 matches q6b, kernel + quant combo is culprit.
Ivy: Command for fuzzy dedupe: `python tools/dedupe.py --threshold 0.82 --input promptset_M.json --out dedup_list.json`
Asha: I'll prep relabel workflow once you post dedup_list.json. Set QA bar at 92% for relabel.
Ivy: Posting dedup_list now: https://internal/gists/dedup_list_1769004321
Ben: Thanks. If relabel shows improved alignment we can try a canary route where longform requests use q6b until we fix kernel.
Ivy: Sounds good — will update with relabel summary and ablation results within 24h.
